body:
## Close-out — both PRs merged

Every still-dead row now has its permanent disposition. Verified per-item outcome:

| Item | Disposition | Landed in |
|---|---|---|
| Theme `spacing`/`breakpoints`/`logo`/`density`/`wcagContrast`/`rtl`/`touchTarget`/`keyboardNavigation` (+ dedicated sub-schemas & types) | **Pruned** — re-verified against the objectui theme engine before deletion: `generateThemeVars` (objectui `packages/core/src/theme/ThemeEngine.ts`) consumes colors/typography/borderRadius/shadows/animation/zIndex/customVars only | #3516 |
| Translation `fileOrganization`/`messageFormat`/`lazyLoad`/`cache` (+ `MessageFormatSchema`, `TranslationFileOrganizationSchema`) | **Pruned** — no ICU engine exists; interpolation is always simple `{variable}` substitution. File layout stays documented as a pure authoring convention | #3516 |
| Translation `supportedLocales` | **Kept** — live reader (pinyin-search toggle, `serve.ts:743`); the audit's "no consumer" wording was stale | — |
| Webhook `body`/`payloadFields`/`includeSession`/`authentication` (non-HMAC)/`retryPolicy`/`tags` + entire inbound `WebhookReceiverSchema` | **Pruned** — delivery sends its fixed envelope, HMAC-via-`secret` stays, outbox owns its own retry schedule; the #3489 materializer reads none of the removed fields. Ledger entries for removed props dropped; the dead→live flip for the materialized props remains #3490's scope | #3516 |
| Webhook `object`→`object_name` / `isActive`→`active` naming drift | **Resolved by the #3489 bridge** (`mapWebhookToRow` remaps); documenting it in the refreshed ledger is part of #3490 | — |
| Job `retryPolicy` / `timeout` | **Built** — `IJobService.schedule` gains an optional `options` arg; `runWithPolicy` enforces exponential-backoff retries and a per-attempt timeout (execution status `'timeout'`) across Cron/Interval/Db adapters; AppPlugin forwards the authored values. Tests verified red-then-green; `[EXPERIMENTAL]` markers removed from the schema | #3529 |
| EmailTemplate "worst drift" | **Excluded** — already fixed by `47a92f427` before the audit was written | — |

Versioning: both PRs ride the `minor` line with `feat(spec)!:` titles + migration notes, per the #2377/#3464 enforce-or-remove precedent.
